description: Unit test class for ExistingVisitAssignmentHandler, testing its behavior when assigning visits to encounters during creation.

classes.name: ExistingVisitAssignmentHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of ExistingVisitAssignmentHandler during encounter creation.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test by executing a dataset XML.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldAssignExistingVisitIfMatchFound
methods.description: Tests that a visit is assigned to an encounter if a matching visit is found.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldNotAssignVisitIfNoMatchFound
methods.description: Tests that no visit is assigned if no matching visit is found for the encounter date.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter_shouldNotAssignVisitWhichStoppedBeforeEncounterDate
methods.description: Tests that a visit which ended before the encounter date is not assigned to the encounter.
